title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：protein　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 protein 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the baker ① needed the protein that no customer in the bakery would have described, and he said the needing was the whole of the week. The ② protein, meaning the nutrient itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; protein, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ piece of protein in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ protein at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Protein, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the baker said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the protein was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the nutrient. The ⑥ protein, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; protein, he said, is either something you need or the only word that means both nutrient and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ protein had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ protein of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of describing; protein, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ protein I remember is the protein described in the bill, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the bakery. ⑩ Protein, my mother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being described; all protein, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like nutrient. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 蛋白质（指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 蛋白质（指那份蛋白质本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：need the protein 摄取这一份蛋白质
D. n. 蛋白质（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 蛋白质之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的蛋白质之事）
F. n. 蛋白质（指账单里写到、被描述的那一份）
G. n. 蛋白质、养分（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 养分（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: needed the protein that no customer in the bakery would have described
The protein, meaning the nutrient itself and not the tray
Every piece of protein in that bakery
the protein at the far oven
the protein was the whole of the matter
the protein had become a line in a bill
The protein of the whole thing

answers.why: need the protein 意为“摄取这一份蛋白质”，1967 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯描述的一份蛋白质做了一遍。
protein 意为“蛋白质”，指那份蛋白质本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
protein 意为“蛋白质”，指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
protein 意为“蛋白质”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
protein 意为“蛋白质、养分”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份养分就是那件事的全部。
protein 意为“养分”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份蛋白质，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
protein 意为“蛋白质”，指账单里写到、被描述的那一份，到 1972 年这一份成了账单里的一行。
protein 意为“蛋白质之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的蛋白质之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的描述。
protein 意为“蛋白质”，我记得的是账单里描述过的那一份，1974 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一份。
protein 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，蛋白质是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的蛋白质。
